faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for VGU?
faqs.answer: VGU’s scholarship page labels its detailed policy as 2025-26. It describes qualifying-mark, alumni/employee and co-curricular categories. Awards are restricted to academic fees for Indian students, credited in even semesters, and continue only with the stated performance and attendance conditions. A current agriculture-specific award should be confirmed separately. Historical general scholarship policy, 2025-26: The policy requires at least 6 SGPA each semester, no detention for attendance shortage and only one applicable category. A later agriculture intake must not assume the older policy continues unchanged.
